note: Repo convention established. An 'agent' here is NOT a prose agent file. It is a five-part artifact set: (1) a check-inventory entry in policy/checks.v1.yaml (or curricula/<name>/checks.v1.yaml) validated by schemas/checks.schema.v1.json; (2) an owner file that states the rule and names the id; (3) accept/reject fixtures under tests/fixtures/<name>.accept|reject.<ext>; (4) either an executing gate in tests/gates/ registered in registry.py with verified_by: FR-..., or a deferred: RT-N entry in policy/deferred.v1.yaml; (5) for anything that runs at unit time, a check function in runtime/checks.py raising CheckFailure. The repo's hard rule is that being listed is not being executed, and the two are never conflated.

note: No interactive user (Phase 4 runs as a background agent), so intent was captured from the Phase 4 prompt and plan v2 rather than an interview. Intent: a factory that turns ONE sota_agents.v<N>.json recommendation object into this repo's concrete agent artifact set, so every reviewer added to the pipeline is created the same way. Explicitly NOT a research scan and no web access (llm_driven_learning owns that, and already verified these sources).

Design decision on what 'creating an agent' means, grounded in runtime/ and policy/ rather than a generic notion of agent. In this repo a reviewer agent is a check id with a home, a subject, a detector and an honest execution status: (1) an entry in policy/checks.v1.yaml OR curricula/<name>/checks.v1.yaml, validated by schemas/checks.schema.v1.json; (2) a release[] row advertising the id at its stage; (3) an owner file that exists and states the rule - defaulting to policy/failures.v1.yaml since every recommendation carries issues_resolved, i.e. an observed defect; (4) an accept/reject fixture pair under tests/fixtures/ reproducing the defect named in issues_resolved; (5) a detector + gate in tests/gates/ registered in registry.py (verified_by: FR-...) or a truthful deferred: RT-N entry in policy/deferred.v1.yaml; (6) a dossier under docs/agents/<CHECK-ID>.md carrying what_makes_it_sota and sources as unre-verified provenance. Rejected alternative: a prose 'agent persona' file, which nothing in this repo reads and which would let a new agent be advertised without a subject or an execution status - the exact A5/B3 failure this repo's inventory exists to prevent.
